name: TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY
description: Get intraday (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min) time series data for a stock symbol. Returns open, high, low, close, volume.

name: TIME_SERIES_DAILY
description: Get daily time series data (open, high, low, close, volume) for a stock symbol, covering 20+ years of historical data.

name: TIME_SERIES_DAILY_ADJUSTED
description: Get daily adjusted time series data including splits and dividends for a stock symbol.

name: TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY
description: Get weekly time series data (open, high, low, close, volume) for a stock symbol.

name: TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY_ADJUSTED
description: Get weekly adjusted time series data including splits and dividends.

name: TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY
description: Get monthly time series data (open, high, low, close, volume) for a stock symbol.

name: TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY_ADJUSTED
description: Get monthly adjusted time series data including splits and dividends.

name: GLOBAL_QUOTE
description: Get the latest price and volume data for a stock symbol. Returns price, change, change percent, volume.

name: SMA
description: Simple Moving Average (SMA) technical indicator for a stock symbol. Smooths price data over a specified period.

name: EMA
description: Exponential Moving Average (EMA) technical indicator. Gives more weight to recent prices than SMA.

name: WMA
description: Weighted Moving Average (WMA) technical indicator for a stock symbol.

name: DEMA
description: Double Exponential Moving Average (DEMA) technical indicator for a stock symbol.

name: TEMA
description: Triple Exponential Moving Average (TEMA) technical indicator.

name: TRIMA
description: Triangular Moving Average (TRIMA) technical indicator.

name: KAMA
description: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (KAMA) technical indicator.

name: MAMA
description: MESA Adaptive Moving Average (MAMA) technical indicator.

name: VWAP
description: Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) for intraday data. Key institutional trading benchmark.

name: T3
description: Triple Exponential Moving Average T3 technical indicator.

name: MACD
description: Moving Average Convergence/Divergence (MACD). Trend-following momentum indicator showing relationship between two moving averages.

name: MACDEXT
description: MACD with controllable moving average types for signal and MACD lines.

name: STOCH
description: Stochastic Oscillator (STOCH). Momentum indicator comparing closing price to price range over a period.

name: STOCHF
description: Stochastic Fast (STOCHF) technical indicator.

name: RSI
description: Relative Strength Index (RSI). Momentum oscillator measuring speed and magnitude of price movements. Overbought above 70, oversold below 30.

name: STOCHRSI
description: Stochastic RSI (STOCHRSI). Applies stochastic formula to RSI values.

name: WILLR
description: Williams %R technical indicator. Momentum indicator measuring overbought/oversold levels.

name: ADX
description: Average Directional Movement Index (ADX). Measures trend strength regardless of direction.

name: ADXR
description: Average Directional Movement Index Rating (ADXR). Smoothed version of ADX.

name: APO
description: Absolute Price Oscillator (APO). Difference between two moving averages.

name: PPO
description: Percentage Price Oscillator (PPO). Percentage difference between two moving averages.

name: MOM
description: Momentum (MOM) technical indicator. Rate of change of price over a period.

name: BOP
description: Balance of Power (BOP). Measures the strength of buyers vs sellers.

name: CCI
description: Commodity Channel Index (CCI). Identifies cyclical trends and overbought/oversold conditions.

name: CMO
description: Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO). Momentum indicator based on difference of up and down days.

name: ROC
description: Rate of Change (ROC). Percentage change in price over a specified period.

name: ROCR
description: Rate of Change Ratio (ROCR). Price ratio over a specified period.

name: AROON
description: Aroon indicator. Identifies trends and likelihood of trend reversal.

name: AROONOSC
description: Aroon Oscillator. Difference between Aroon Up and Aroon Down.

name: MFI
description: Money Flow Index (MFI). Volume-weighted RSI, measures buying and selling pressure.

name: TRIX
description: Triple Smooth EMA (TRIX). Rate of change of triple-smoothed moving average.

name: ULTOSC
description: Ultimate Oscillator. Combines short, medium, and long-term price momentum.

name: DX
description: Directional Movement Index (DX). Measures strength of price movement direction.

name: MINUS_DI
description: Minus Directional Indicator (-DI). Measures downward price movement.

name: PLUS_DI
description: Plus Directional Indicator (+DI). Measures upward price movement.

name: MINUS_DM
description: Minus Directional Movement (-DM). Raw downward price movement.

name: PLUS_DM
description: Plus Directional Movement (+DM). Raw upward price movement.

name: BBANDS
description: Bollinger Bands (BBANDS). Volatility bands placed above and below a moving average. Useful for identifying overbought/oversold conditions.

name: MIDPOINT
description: Midpoint value over a period. Average of highest and lowest prices.

name: MIDPRICE
description: Midpoint Price over a period. Average of high and low prices.

name: SAR
description: Parabolic SAR (Stop and Reverse). Trailing stop-loss indicator for trend following.

name: TRANGE
description: True Range. Measures volatility as the greatest of current high-low, abs(high-prev close), abs(low-prev close).

name: ATR
description: Average True Range (ATR). Volatility indicator showing average price range over a period.

name: NATR
description: Normalized Average True Range (NATR). ATR as a percentage of closing price.

name: AD
description: Chaikin A/D Line. Volume-based indicator measuring cumulative money flow.

name: ADOSC
description: Chaikin A/D Oscillator. Difference between fast and slow Chaikin A/D Line EMAs.

name: OBV
description: On Balance Volume (OBV). Cumulative volume indicator that relates volume to price change direction.

name: HT_TRENDLINE
description: Hilbert Transform - Instantaneous Trendline. Extracts the dominant cycle from price data.

name: HT_SINE
description: Hilbert Transform - SineWave. Identifies market cycles and turning points.

name: HT_TRENDMODE
description: Hilbert Transform - Trend vs Cycle Mode. Binary indicator of whether market is trending or cycling.

name: HT_DCPERIOD
description: Hilbert Transform - Dominant Cycle Period. Period of the dominant price cycle.

name: HT_DCPHASE
description: Hilbert Transform - Dominant Cycle Phase. Phase of the dominant price cycle.

name: HT_PHASOR
description: Hilbert Transform - Phasor Components. In-phase and quadrature components of price cycle.

name: OVERVIEW

name: INCOME_STATEMENT

name: BALANCE_SHEET
description: Annual and quarterly balance sheets. Total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, debt.

name: CASH_FLOW
description: Annual and quarterly cash flow statements. Operating, investing, and financing cash flows.

name: EARNINGS
description: Annual and quarterly earnings data including EPS, estimated EPS, surprise, and surprise percentage.

name: LISTING_STATUS
description: List of active and delisted stocks, ETFs, and mutual funds with IPO dates and exchange info.

name: EARNINGS_CALENDAR
description: Upcoming earnings announcements for the next 3 months with estimated EPS.

name: IPO_CALENDAR
description: Upcoming and recent IPOs with pricing, share count, and exchange information.

name: INSIDER_TRANSACTIONS
description: Insider trading transactions including buys, sells, and option exercises by company officers.

name: CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE

name: FX_INTRADAY

name: FX_DAILY

name: FX_WEEKLY
description: Weekly forex time series data for a currency pair.

name: FX_MONTHLY
description: Monthly forex time series data for a currency pair.

name: CRYPTO_EXCHANGE_RATE
description: Real-time exchange rate for a cryptocurrency pair (e.g. BTC/USD, ETH/EUR).

name: DIGITAL_CURRENCY_DAILY
description: Daily cryptocurrency time series data in both crypto and fiat currency.

name: DIGITAL_CURRENCY_WEEKLY
description: Weekly cryptocurrency time series data.

name: DIGITAL_CURRENCY_MONTHLY
description: Monthly cryptocurrency time series data.

name: WTI

name: BRENT
description: Brent crude oil prices. Daily, weekly, or monthly intervals.

name: NATURAL_GAS

name: ALUMINUM

name: WHEAT

name: CORN

name: COTTON
description: Global cotton prices.

name: SUGAR
description: Global sugar prices.

name: COFFEE
description: Global coffee prices.

name: ALL_COMMODITIES
description: Global commodity price index across all major categories.

name: REAL_GDP

name: REAL_GDP_PER_CAPITA
description: US Real GDP per capita. Annual data.

name: TREASURY_YIELD

name: FEDERAL_FUNDS_RATE
description: Federal Funds effective interest rate set by the Federal Reserve.

name: CPI

name: INFLATION

name: RETAIL_SALES

name: DURABLES

name: UNEMPLOYMENT

name: NONFARM_PAYROLL
description: US nonfarm payroll employment data. Key monthly jobs report.

name: NEWS_SENTIMENT
description: Market news and sentiment data for stocks, topics, and sectors. AI-powered sentiment scoring.

name: TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS

name: MARKET_STATUS

name: REALTIME_OPTIONS

name: FIXED_INCOME_CORPORATE
